summary: santana-baileys ships char-code-obfuscated exfiltration host in messages-send
details: santana-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. lib/Socket/messages-send.js contains a String.fromCharCode(...) array whose decoded value is the hardcoded URL https://fiora.nixel.my.id/, reconstructed inside the message-send code path. The destination is obfuscated (assembled from a decimal-ASCII char-code array rather than appearing as a plain string), is not a documented Baileys/WhatsApp endpoint, and is unrelated to the package's stated messaging purpose. Injecting an obfuscated third-party host into the outgoing-message path of a WhatsApp library is the shape of a covert relay/exfiltration channel that runs whenever the consumer's session sends messages, leaking session-owned data to an attacker-controlled server.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
